protocol.purpose: Offline retrospective diagnostic of feature selection, risk classification, sigmoid calibration and subsequent evaluation. No PPO integration or orders.

selection.method: StandardScaler + SelectFromModel(LogisticRegression L1, solver saga), threshold mean; union with protectedIndices
selection.criterion: Minimum mean inner chronological log loss of the complete pipeline and its classifier; ties choose first C. Neither outer calibration nor evaluation tunes C.

protocol.calibration: Freeze the fitted training pipeline with FrozenEstimator, then fit CalibratedClassifierCV(method=sigmoid) on the separate, later calibration block. No base refit on calibration.
metrics: multiclass Brier (unscaled sum across three classes)
baselines: training class frequencies with Laplace smoothing
training ATR/price tercile class frequencies with Laplace smoothing

bootstrap.note: Paired differences in Brier, averaged over seeds for each case before daily block resampling. Keeps both candidate directions in the same block. Conditional descriptive uncertainty; no training or asset-selection uncertainty captured.

protocol.label: Maximum adverse price excursion in the next30m from the next1m opening reference with adverse entry slippage. Low <0.5 initial stop distance; moderate 0.5..<1; high >=1. This is a future-path label, not an input, probability of profit, or a net trading return; fees/funding are not part of this label.
dataRules: Features must be known at decision time.
Every future label fully matures within its split and month; candidate directions at the same timestamp never cross a split.
Inner fitting labels mature at least30min before inner validation starts.
Both directions are scored only when the first execution minute has volume; skipped windows are counted.
August2024 is excluded consistently because the installed financial research omitted its incomplete mark-price data.
interpretation: All periods have already been available to prior research. Temporal separation within this experiment does not make them an untouched independent final test.
No 2025-07+ packets opened. The V3 prospective final test remains locked.
Three seeds check selector optimization stability, not three independent market histories.
A lower Brier or log loss does not by itself demonstrate better calibration at every probability level or profitable trading.
Protected availability flags and candidate direction remain even if rare/constant. No portfolio features are removed from the separate PPO.
No winner is promoted automatically. Financial utility requires a separately registered continuous-wallet comparison with costs and CDI.
protocol.primaryEvaluationMetric: Log loss, weighted equally per evaluated candidate across the three nonoverlapping windows; Brier and reliability reported separately.

conclusion: A seleção com calibração não demonstrou redução consistente do Brier nas três janelas pelo critério registrado. O menor log loss observado foi logistic_all_raw. Resultado retrospectivo de classificação; não comprova lucro e não promove um filtro ao PPO.
